intent: Light warm green-bronze Grashan sentinel plate with a pale ruin-stone mask, chest slab and strip kilt, stone-topped slab pauldrons, a gold sun half-disc and thick rays behind the helm, and a large gold sun-cross on the back, all reading from the high camera.
reason: Sunburst sentinel: a radiating gold sunburst crest and wide pale-stone shoulder slabs over dark old bronze, one strong idea that reads from the ARPG camera and looks like no other family (second critic 7.8, first; first critic 7.0, second).
first_fix: Make the crest rays fewer, broader and duller so they read as cast bronze, not feathers; cover the green thigh gap; simplify the toothed waist fringe.
